content: One-off premii/bonuses are added to the same cumulative annual income base as salary for NDFL purposes (no separate scale) - they push the cumulative total further up the 5-step scale, and only the portion of income that crosses a threshold is taxed at the higher rate. Dividends and severny nadbavki/rayonny koeffitsient (northern/regional allowances) are a SEPARATE tax base in 2025 (own thresholds), not combined with salary income for progressive-scale purposes.
